messages:
hana: Quick thread: design review for API Keys page. Goals: make secret reveal safer, make revoke less scary, and make rotation explicit (no silent swaps). Dropped a compact mock: https://redwood.design/keys-compact

tom: Saw the mock. Strong +1 to separating steps. Proposal: Create modal collects name/scopes/expiry. After create, show a transient reveal panel that lasts 20s with one prominent 'Copy' button and a small 'Download' affordance. After timeout, mask the secret and show 'Shown once' badge.

rachel: Accessibility checklist: announce reveal via `role=alert` so it reads immediately. Eye toggle should have `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` = 'Show API key'. Make sure screenreader hears the 'shown once' note. Keyboard focus order: modal -> copy button -> download -> done.

omar: Rotation UX: don't auto-replace in-place. Flow: 1) create rotated key, 2) optionally start grace window (default 12h), 3) monitor dependents, 4) finalize revoke. UI surfaces 'pending revocation' state with countdown and cancel option. Also show estimated # of linked services (best-effort) so users know risk.

hana: Revoke modal copy suggestion: short, clear, calm.

``
Revoke this key?
This key will no longer grant access once revoked. Create a replacement first if you need uninterrupted service.
[Revoke key] [Cancel]
``

tom: Microcopy note: prefer 'will no longer grant access' for clarity. Also add a small link 'How to rotate safely' to the revoke modal.

rachel: Contrast and semantics: warning banner must be 4.5:1 and use `role=alert`. Also ensure toasts for copy/revoke are announced via `aria-live=polite`.

cli-bot: audit-log: reveal_event logged for hana/session-93.

omar: Bulk rotate: offer a single slider to set grace window across selected keys, default enabled. If user chooses to 'auto-revoke', surface a big red confirmation and require typing the word 'revoke' for >5 keys.

hana: OK next steps: tom to prototype two-step create + transient reveal, rachel to add aria attributes and keyboard test-cases, omar to mock pending-revocation state and bulk rotate confirm. I'll consolidate copy and push to staging. Thanks all!
